description: Create or change one custom property definition (type is required to create; only the fields you pass change; a type change rewrites no task). Or rename it: rename_key renames the key on the definition and on every task carrying it, rename_option renames one option label on the definition and in every task value naming it, across inline tasks in every format and task files, and in every space whose filters, sort, grouping, columns, card properties or defaults name it. A key another property holds is refused (duplicate_key). Run a rename with dry_run:true first: it returns the task count, each task's before/after lines and the spaces, and writes nothing. The app's validator decides, so a refusal carries the same code the app shows (reserved_builtin, duplicate_key, ...). Definitions live in the vault settings file and sync to every device.

acknowledge_count.description:
Required for a real rename (not a dry run): the task count the dry run
reported. A rename whose count differs is refused and writes nothing,
the same blast-radius check the bulk tools make.

dry_run.description:
Validate and report without writing. For a rename: the task count
and each task's before/after lines.

icon.description: Icon name; an empty string clears it.

key.description:
The property key, exactly as tasks spell it. Matched
case-insensitively against existing definitions.

options.description: Options of a select or multiSelect, in order. Replaces the whole list.

color.description:
A palette colour: grey, orange, amber, green, teal, blue, indigo,
purple, pink or rose.

label.description: The option label. No `,` or `]` (the inline `[key:: a, b]` form).

rename_key.description:
Rename the key, on the definition and on every task carrying it. Not
combinable with other changes.

rename_option.description:
Rename one option label, on the definition and in every task value
naming it. Not combinable with other changes.

rules.description:
"Some tasks" rules: filter conditions `{type, operator, value}` on
tag, project, context, file_path, full_file_path or
task_source_type. Replaces the whole list.

scope.description:
Which tasks show the field: all, some (the `rules`) or none (only
tasks that already carry a value).

type.description:
text, number, date, datetime, checkbox, select, multiSelect or link.
Required to create; on an existing property a type change rewrites no
task.

name: set_property
